defs.def: the remaining part of sth 剩余部分；残留；其余

ex.s: They often cover only their eyes with their hands, leaving the rest of their bodies _23__ .
ex.t: 他们常常只用双手遮住眼睛，把身体的____23____（其余部分）露在外面。

ex.s: But for the rest of the time she is a super dog, and we are all really proud of her."
ex.t: 但在其余时间里，她是一只超级好狗，我们都为她感到非常骄傲。

ex.s: Then lay the tube in place so that one end rests all the way in the cup and the rest of the line runs up — and out — the side of the hole.
ex.t: 然后铺设管子，使一端一直伸到杯子里，管线的其余部分向上延伸——并穿出——洞的一侧。

defs.def: the remaining people or things; the others 其余的人；其他事物；其他

ex.s: She decided that she would memorize where her classes were and then pretend that the rest of the place didn’t exist.
ex.t: 她决定记住教室都在哪里，然后假装其他地方都不存在。

ex.s: To set an example for the rest of the class.
ex.t: 火车旅行不适合急性子的人。

ex.s: Still, sometimes our assumptions are incorrect, and scientific findings surprise researchers, along with the rest of us.
ex.t: 尽管如此，有时我们的假设是错误的，科学发现会让研究人员和我们其他人一样感到惊讶。

ex.s: Europe £55    Rest of World £65
ex.t: 欧洲 £55 世界其他地区 £65

ex.s: Europe £60    Rest of World £70
ex.t: 欧洲 £60 世界其他地区 £70

ex.s: Why is it that some people are so much more intelligent or creative than the rest of us?
ex.t: 为什么有些人比我们其他人聪明或更有创造力那么多？

ex.s: Ahead of its time, the submarine is also a secret from the rest of the world.
ex.t: 这艘潜艇超前于它所处的时代，对世界其他地方来说也是一个秘密。

defs.def: a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing after a period of activity 休息时间；睡眠时间

ex.s: I probably would have continued trying to keep up with him for the rest of my high school career, but when my family moved, everything changed.
ex.t: 我很可能还会在整个高中剩下的时间里努力跟上他，但当我们家搬家时，一切都变了。

ex.s: “I reflect on how my day's gone and think about the rest of the week,” he said.
ex.t: "我反思这一天过得怎么样，想想这一周剩下的时间，"他说。

ex.s: (WHO), these patterns of activity and rest arise ___25___ habits we develop early in life, “What we really need to do is ___26___ (bring) back play for children,” says Dr Juana Williamson, a WHO specialist in childhood obesity and physical activity, in a statement about new WHO guidelines issued in April 2019.
ex.t: （WHO称），这些活动和休息的模式源于我们早年养成的____25____（习惯），“我们真正需要做的是____26____（bring 找回）孩子们的玩耍，”世界卫生组织儿童肥胖与身体活动专家Juana Williamson博士在2019年4月发布的WHO新指南声明中说。

ex.s: Stop to have a rest now and then.
ex.t: 不时停下来休息一下。

ex.s: Taking the time ___11___ (rest) allows us to develop a deeper sense of ___12___ (self-aware).
ex.t: 花时间____（休息）能让我们培养更深层次的____（自我意识）。

ex.s: He took the chance to rest     D.
ex.t: 他趁机休息 D。

ex.s: The horses, whether resting or on the move, offered him plenty of inspiration.
ex.t: 这些马，无论是在休息还是在运动，都给了他大量的灵感。

defs.def: an object that is used to support or hold sth 常构成复合词

ex.s: How we feel about ourselves rests not just on whom we compare ourselves with but also on how we think about that comparison.
ex.t: 我们对自己的感受，不仅仅取决于我们与谁比较，还取决于我们如何看待那种比较。

defs.def: a period of silence between notes; a sign that shows a rest between notes 休止；休止符

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: Jenna told Jeff to clean it up so they could continue to cook the rest of the porridge.
ex.t: 珍娜让杰夫把它清理干净，这样他们就可以继续煮剩下的粥。

ex.s: About 100 of these stayed rich men for the rest of their lives.
ex.t: 其中约100人作为富翁度过了余生。

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: She ran the rest of the race with just one shoe on and her right foot bare.
ex.t: 她只穿着一只鞋、右脚光着跑完了剩下的比赛。

ex.s: Sherman Cymru is excited to present a packed programme of the very best theatre, dance, family shows and music from Wales and the rest of the world.
ex.t: Sherman Cymru很兴奋地推出一系列精彩的戏剧、舞蹈、家庭演出以及来自威尔士和世界各地的音乐节目。

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: When he brings his speech to a nice conclusion ,Whaley invites the rest of the class to praise him.
ex.t: 当他把演讲圆满结束时，惠利邀请全班同学表扬他。

defs.def: dead and therefore free from trouble or anxiety. People say ‘at rest’ to avoid saying ‘dead’. （委婉说法，与 dead 同义）安息，长眠
to relax, sleep or do nothing after a period of activity or illness; to not use a part of your body for some time 休息；放松

ex.s: Well, while I was sleeping, Dad stopped for some petrol and Mum also got out to take photos, and you can guess the rest...
ex.t: 嗯，在我睡觉的时候，爸爸停下来加油，妈妈也下车拍照，后面的你们可以猜到……

ex.s: Babies need a lot of rest: most of them sleep about 18 hours a day!
ex.t: 婴儿需要大量休息：他们大多数人每天睡约18小时！

ex.s: In fact, the key to easy morning wake-up lies in resting your body clock   36     Here is how to make one.
ex.t: 事实上，轻松早起的关键在于让您的生物钟得到休息____36____。以下是如何做到这一点。

ex.s: Though it is the only unnatural thing on your way up the mountain, still it highlights the whole adventure ___62___ offers a place where you can sit down to rest your ___63___ (ache) legs.
ex.t: 虽然它是你上山路上唯一不自然的东西，但它突出了整个冒险___62___，并提供了一个你可以坐下来让___63____（ache 酸痛的）腿休息的地方。

defs.def: to support sth by putting it on or against sth; to be supported in this way （被）支撑；（使）倚靠；托

ex.s: The ship rests upright on the sea bed, about 30 metres below the waves.
ex.t: 这艘船直立地静卧在海床上，大约在海浪下30米处。

defs.def: if you let a matter rest, you stop discussing it or dealing with it 被搁置；中止
to be buried. People say ‘rest’ to avoid saying ‘be buried’ （委婉说法，与 be buried 同义）安息，长眠
我的论证到此为止（已经足够）

ex.s: As my eyes rested on them, I felt as though I were looking through a window into my own past.
ex.t: 当我的目光停留在它们身上时，我感到仿佛透过一扇窗户窥见了自己的过去。

defs.def: （律师在法庭上）对案情陈述完毕
to depend or rely on sb/sth 依靠；依赖
to look at sb/sth 凝视；凝望
